## Problem and result

Explain the problem and the behavior after this change. Link the related issue.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their results. For UI changes, include screenshots
with synthetic data and the window sizes and appearances checked. State any
checks you could not run.

## Contribution checklist

- [ ] I read CONTRIBUTING.md and signed off my commits under the DCO.
- [ ] The change has a focused scope and appropriate validation.
- [ ] I identified any copied third-party material and included its license notices.
- [ ] The changes and attachments contain no credentials or private user data.
